description: Five acute days against the same chronic block puts the ratio at 1.54, at or above the high bound, so the state is deload. The old sum-based ratio read this shape as 0.65 and called it 'build'; recommending progression during a spike is the defect this scenario pins.

disclaimers: Workload ratio, a monitoring signal only. Not an injury probability, risk score or diagnosis.
Stop and seek a qualified clinician for pain that persists, altered gait, chest pain, or any medical concern. Nothing here is a diagnosis.
recommend.limitation: Reduce volume; do not add intensity to compensate.
